newsitem.title: LATVIA: LMT MOBILE PHONE OPERATOR CUTS TARIFFS.
newsitem.headline: LMT MOBILE PHONE OPERATOR CUTS TARIFFS.

text.p: Latvijas Mobilais Telefons, one of the two mobile phone operators in Latvia, on Friday said that it cut tariffs for calls to Lattelekom and Baltkom GSM network numbers in Riga and the surrounding region.
The tariffs will be cut from June 1 by two santimes to 17 santimes per minute for weekdays and to 12 santimes during evenings and weekends, the company said in a statement.

"Growing competition is one of the reasons behind the cut and another is the increased number of clients which allows us to reduce the costs of system operation," Peteris Galejs, LMT advertising official, told Reuters.
This is the third price cut in three months, Galejs said. It earlier levelled out tariffs for local and international calls, cutting the latter by 25 percent.
Other mobile oprator, Baltkom GSM, which launched its service earlier this year, offered free local calls for the first 5,000 subscribers and a 50 percent reduction for the rest of its clientelle.
